subject: SS
title: Priests, soldiers and legal rights
teach: Priests performed religious ceremonies and rituals. The readings explain that Egyptians believed these rituals helped keep the gods pleased. Report this as an Egyptian belief, not as a scientific cause of flooding.

Soldiers defended Egypt. The OER reading says successful soldiers could receive land from the pharaoh and keep wealth from conquered lands. This could improve their social position; a reward was not guaranteed to every soldier.

The teacher’s society mystery states that women could own property and conduct business and had many of the same legal rights as men. This does not mean every woman and man had the same power or experience.

example.prompt: A woman owns property and runs a business. Does that match the teacher’s society reading?
example.thinking: The assigned question identifies property ownership and business as rights available to women. It does not say everyone held equal power.
example.answer: Yes. Those activities match the legal rights described.
example.why: Use the specific rights in the source without turning them into a claim of complete equality.

teachingSections.tryPrompt: Which group performed important temple rituals?
teachingSections.tryAnswer: Priests. They carried out important religious ceremonies and temple rituals.

connections.prompt: Why does a soldier’s possible land reward differ from a woman’s property right?
options: One is a possible reward; the other is a specific legal right.
Both mean every person held the same power as the ruler.
Both are names for the same religious ceremony.
connections.rationale: One is a possible reward; the other is a specific legal right. Distinguish a religious belief, a possible military reward and a legal right without making a claim about everyone.

connections.prompt: A person can own property without running a government. How does this help interpret women’s rights?
options: A property right does not prove equal political power.
Owning property automatically makes someone a pharaoh.
People with property never have any legal limits.
connections.rationale: A property right does not prove equal political power. Owning a small business does not make someone a government leader. A specific right and political power are different ideas.
